what_this_release_is: ATLAS is connected to the REAL Kalshi production account in READ_ONLY. Authentication, balance and reconciliation are verified against the live account. Zero broker writes. The full live SHADOW is NOT yet running: an equity drawdown computed against a near-empty account cuts the scan before any market is looked at.

builder.proof: BuildKit emitted the Dockerfile stage step '[tests 7/7] RUN python -c ...test_report.json...', matching 'FROM python AS tests' in the Dockerfile, and ran the project suite as a build step. Railpack never runs a project's test suite and has no stage named tests.
builder.finding: The service-level stored builder reads RAILPACK while railway.json pins DOCKERFILE. Config-as-code wins at build time, so the deployed image is the Dockerfile image. The stored setting is misleading and should be corrected to DOCKERFILE so the two agree.

why_the_shadow_is_not_running.observed: Drawdown 1222.0% (0.48$) >= 20% -- trading coupe. Eight consecutive cycles recorded blocking_global_guard=equity_drawdown with scan_executed=false.
why_the_shadow_is_not_running.cause: The live account holds 0.04$ against roughly -0.48$ of persisted historical PnL, so the rolling drawdown reads over 1200%. The guard is behaving exactly as designed; it is protecting an exposure that READ_ONLY cannot take.

open_findings.summary: An async def METHOD inside a unittest.TestCase can still report green. tests/_collect.py refuses module-level async and generator functions and fails an un-awaited result, but does not inspect methods of collected TestCase classes. unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase is legitimately exempt.
open_findings.reproduced: pytest reports 1 passed for a deliberately failing async test method while run_tests.py exits 0 and reports ran:950
open_findings.fix_status: NOT REVIEWED, NOT MERGED, NOT DEPLOYED
open_findings.note: Recorded deliberately rather than concealed. It affects the artifact the LIVE gatekeeper reads, so it must close before capital.

open_findings.summary: Provenance telemetry is computed but never logged. Binance klines returned HTTP 451 in 468 of 468 DEMO cycles and a fallback supplied data every cycle, but accepted providers log at DEBUG only, and data_quality_score, klines source, spot_sources and source_dispersion are never emitted. Which provider actually fed the model is unobservable from logs.
open_findings.consequence: The per-decision provenance fields the audit requires will be MISSING on the LIVE shadow stream until telemetry is added.

open_findings.summary: Railway's stored service builder reads RAILPACK while railway.json pins DOCKERFILE. The Dockerfile is what actually builds, but the two settings disagree and a future change to railway.json handling would silently switch builders.
The Dockerfile runtime stage ships run_tests.py, tests/ and _bootstrap.py into the deployed image. No execution path reaches them.
tools/restart_harness.py runs in no CI step and in neither Docker stage.
